title: First 2027 Comrades Marathon Entry Window Closed, Record for Charity Donations Already Broken
claims: Entry Window 1 was reserved for Green Number-holders (runners with 10 or more medals) and Yellow Numbers (runners on nine medals aiming for Green Number in 2027); it opened at 10:00 on Tuesday 25 August 2026 and sold out in seven hours, first come first served, with a scheduled close of Monday 31 August at 16:30 or sooner if capacity was reached.

2026 was the third year of the Green Number early window and the first time Yellow Numbers were included; Green and Yellow runners unable to secure a place could try Window 2 as eligible CMA members or the General Ballot in Window 3.

1,000 Amabeadibeadi Charity Entries went on sale with Window 1: a guaranteed entry at the applicable base fee plus a compulsory R10,000 charitable contribution per entry to the official CMA Amabeadibeadi Charity Drive; by 10:00 on Wednesday 26 August more than 800 had been sold.

Total charity donations reached R8,662,714 by then, breaking the previous record of R8,012,438 raised at the 2025 Comrades Marathon; the 2027 centenary target is R15 million across eight official Amabeadibeadi Charities.

Entry Window 2 opened Wednesday 2 September 2026 at 10:00 for CMA Members who had signed up for annual membership by 18 August 2026; first come first served, it closed Saturday 5 September at 10:00 or sooner if capacity was reached.

Entry Window 3, the General Ballot, opened Wednesday 9 September at 10:00 and closed Tuesday 22 September at 16:30; the ballot draw was held Wednesday 23 September, and successful applicants were notified immediately after the draw.
All 2027 entries are taken online via the Comrades Marathon website or the Comrades Marathon app.
